messages:
Asha: Anyone have sleepy/read-before-bed recs? Looking for 10-15 min stories or single tracks under 4 min to wind down.
Ben: 'The Night Face Up' (Julio Cortazar) — short surreal, ~10 min. Song: 'Holocene' — Bon Iver (5:36) is a hair long but calming.
Tori: For <4min tracks: 'Sea of Love' — Cat Power (2:33), 'Suzanne' — Leonard Cohen (3:48). Short story: 'Cathedral' (Raymond Carver) is gentle and quiet.
Liam: Pocket-sized: flash pieces by Lydia Davis (2-3 pages) — super good. Also try 'The Happy Prince' (Oscar Wilde) if you want melancholy but warm.
zack-bot: Saved picks to #book-exchange and added a 'wind-down' playlist template: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/example-winddown
Asha: Love those. Any spoken-word or ASMR-esque tracks?
Ben: Try 'Night Owl' — Galimatias (3:20) or 'Weightless' — Marconi Union (8:00) — long but great for naps.
Tori: Microfiction rec: 'Girl' (Katherine Mansfield) is tiny and bittersweet. Also check 'Tiny Texts' for daily micro hits.
Liam: Poll: react with :book: for short story recs, :cd: for songs, :bookmark_tabs: for microfiction.
Asha: :book:
Ben: :cd:
Tori: :bookmark_tabs:
Asha: If people want, I'll compile a 'train-to-bed' playlist + reading doc. DM me if you want edit access. :sparkles:
